correctness.rationale: Exact reduction under δ=s gives u=v² and zP(z)/(m+z²). P(0)>0 and leading coefficient -h<0 give existence. P″ has precisely one positive zero, so P′ is unimodal and P has at most three positive roots with complete a,b sign test. The Jacobian identity det J=-szP′/(m+z²) identifies all simple equilibria as sinks/saddles. Exact Q signs prove three simple positive roots at the witness, and their nonzero Jacobian determinants give robust continuation by the implicit-function theorem. 543 exact-rational verifier assertions corroborate algebra and signs; no finite-only inference.

value.rationale: The condition δ=s exactly cancels logistic low-density growth against emigration and therefore is a natural structural threshold. An if-and-only-if multiplicity classification, sharp maximum, two distinct positive stable states and an open-parameter robustness consequence resolve a motivated missing piece of the source’s linear model; the achievement is more than a numerical curiosity or generic bistability slogan.
